extracted.name: Beetroot, apple & broad bean tabbouleh
extracted.description: Celebrate beetroot and its glorious earthy flavour by putting it centre stage in this tabbouleh. It works beautifully with the apple, feta and broad beans
ingredient_lines: 2 raw beetroot peeled, trimmed and finely sliced
instruction_lines: Tip the bulgur into a sieve and rinse under cold water. Cook in a pan of boiling water following pack instructions. Drain and leave to cool.

Crush the coriander seeds, then tip into a pan and dry-fry for 3 mins until just toasted. Toss the bulgur with the toasted seeds, the parsley, apple, broad beans, beetroot, lemon juice and rapeseed oil.
Spoon the tabbouleh onto a serving platter and scatter over the feta and pistachios.
